div.head: Rect 4.3, 4.3a, 4.3b, 4.3c
div.ab: On ðam sylfum lande ðe ðeos ræden on stænt gebu|re gebyreð þæt him man to landsetene sylle . ii. oxan. 7. i. cu . 7. vi.sceap.7 vii . æceras ge|sawene on his gyrde landes. forðige ofer þæt gear ealle gerihtu ðe him to gebyrigean . 7 sylle him man tol to his weorce 7 andlaman to his huse . ðonne him forðsit [read as 6 ‘sið’] gebyrige gy|me his hlaford ðæs he læfe.

On the same estate which this custom stands, it is fitting to give to the peasant [as needed] for settling the land, two oxen and one cow and six sheep and seven acres [already] sewn on his strip of land. After the [first] year is over he must fulfil all the duties which pertain to him. And one should give to him tools for his work and utensils for his house. When he dies, the lord should care for that which he leaves [behind].

[4.3] On ðam sylfum lande, ðe ðeos ræden on stænt, gebure gebyreð, þæt him man to landsetene sylle II oxan 7 I cu 7 VI sceap.7 VII æceras gesawene on his gyrde landes. [4.3a] Forðige ofer þæt gear ealle gerihtu, ðe him to gebyrigean. [4.3b] 7 sylle him man tol to his weorce 7 andlaman to his huse. [4.3c] Ðonne him forðsi[ð] gebyrige, gyme his hlaford ðæs he læfe.
